name: even nonlinearities
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 含位移等变量偶次幂非线性项的力学关系。
usage_overview: 在非线性随机振子分析中，以位移或速度的平方等偶次幂项体现，用于考察响应概率分布的变化；在这类模型中，可引起均值偏移和分布不对称。

complete_examples.text: The transient PDF solutions of the following systems with even nonlinearities are presented to verify the effectiveness and efficiency of the EPC method.
It is also found from the numerical analysis that the transient PDF responses of the system are not symmetric about their nonzero means due to the existence of even nonlinearities.

P045.title: Transient probabilistic solutions of stochastic oscillator with even nonlinearities by exponential polynomial closure method
P045.authors: K Wang, Z Zhu, L Xu
P045.label: Wang等（2022）

contexts.text: 位移或速度的二次等偶次幂项，可使响应分布发生偏移与不对称。
